China commerce ministry says dual-use items export-control announcement takes effect November 18
events.summary: China's Ministry of Commerce announced further work on optimising export-control concerns and identification for dual-use items, with the announcement taking effect on November 18. Full scope was not detailed in the first wire headlines.

events.title: Shenghe Resources plans to sell 51% stakes in four rare-earth units to China Rare Earth Group
events.summary: Shenghe Resources announced a plan to bring a China Rare Earth Group unit into 51% stakes of Leshan Shenghe and three other smelting and separation subsidiaries for a projected 1.66 to 1.81 billion yuan, further consolidating China's rare-earth processing under the state group.

events.title: US sanctions five entities tied to Chinese national Ding over alleged AI trade-secret theft
events.summary: Treasury's OFAC issued its first PAIPA designations, sanctioning five entities connected to Chinese national Ding over alleged trade-secret theft, with associated general licenses.

events.title: China proposes adding 40 AI, biotech and solar technologies to its export control list
events.summary: China's commerce ministry proposed adding 40 technologies, including AI models, agents and computing clusters, biomedicine and photovoltaic tech, to its catalogue of technologies prohibited or restricted from export; comments are open until Nov 15 and an interim registration requirement for transfers abroad takes effect immediately.

events.title: China tightens export controls on solar-manufacturing tech, tunnel boring machines, dredgers and drones
events.summary: China's commerce ministry announced licence requirements for exports of high-end equipment including tunnel boring machines, dredgers and drones, and proposed export controls on key solar-manufacturing technologies, reports say targeting India and the US.

events.title: Taiwan to curb AI chip exports to China as part of US trade deal
events.summary: Bloomberg reported Taiwan will restrict exports of advanced AI chips to China under its trade deal with the US. Earlier reporting (June) said Taipei was weighing rules covering all Chinese customers and making smuggling a crime.

events.title: European Commission to fund rare-earth magnet production in Estonia
events.summary: ERR News reported the European Commission will fund rare-earth magnet production in Estonia, part of efforts to reduce reliance on China.

events.title: China Rare Earth Resources and Technology sees nine-month net profit up 89% to 141%
events.summary: China Rare Earth Resources and Technology forecast nine-month net profit up 88.96% to 140.99% year on year, in line with strong rare-earth prices that lifted sector peers' first-half results.

events.title: US holds secret talks with Myanmar as rare earth minerals at stake
events.summary: The Times of India reports the US has held secret talks with Myanmar with access to the country's heavy rare earth deposits, mainly in Kachin state and now largely exported to China, at stake.

events.title: China indicates rare earths will keep flowing to EU regardless of US trade deal expiry
events.summary: CNBC reports China signalled rare-earth exports to the EU will continue even as the one-year US-China export-control suspension nears expiry; the EU sources nearly 99% of its rare earths from China.

events.title: EU seeks sanctions swap with China to save rare-earth-dependent ASML supplier
events.summary: The EU is negotiating to delist an unnamed Chinese firm from its Russia sanctions in exchange for China lifting sanctions on Sindlhauser Materials, a German ASML supplier fully reliant on Chinese rare earths that could shut within months. The two sides also discussed early warning of future export restrictions.

events.title: Trump waives some Russia sanctions, restrictions and energy-linked duties under the Graham Act
events.summary: Trump signed an executive order waiving application of certain sanctions, restrictions and duties under the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (signed Sept 18, initial measures due Oct 18) and certified to Congress that the waivers serve US national interests; Bloomberg says the waivers cover Russia energy tariffs.

events.title: Lutnick challenges tariff reduction for Mexico
events.summary: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick pushed back on a tariff reduction for Mexico, as auto parts makers seek guidance after Mexico limited its tariff break.

episodes.t: China halts rare earths to Japan
episodes.lesson: The first use of the rare-earth weapon; prices later collapsed as China resumed exports.
m: Lynas and Molycorp soared, then crashed
